In-memory and distributed caching toolkit for Elixir

## Modules

- [Nebulex](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.md): Nebulex is split into two main components
- [Nebulex.Cache](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Cache.md): Cache abstraction layer inspired by
[Ecto](https://github.com/elixir-ecto/ecto).
- [Nebulex.Event](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Event.md): Nebulex cache event.

- [Nebulex.Event.CacheEntryEvent](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Event.CacheEntryEvent.md): A cache entry event.

- Caching decorators
  - [Nebulex.Caching](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Caching.md): At its core, the abstraction applies caching to Elixir functions, reducing
thus the number of executions based on the information available in the
cache. That is, each time a targeted function is invoked, the abstraction
will apply a caching behavior checking whether the function has been already
executed and its result cached for the given arguments. If it has, then the
cached result is returned without having to execute the actual function;
if it has not, then the function is executed, the result cached and returned
to the user so that, the next time the method is invoked, the cached result
is returned. This way, expensive functions (whether CPU or IO bound) can be
executed only once for a given set of parameters and the result reused
without having to actually execute the function again. The caching logic
is applied transparently without any interference to the invoker.
  - [Nebulex.Caching.Decorators](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Caching.Decorators.md): Declarative decorator-based caching, inspired by
[Spring Cache Abstraction][spring-cache].
  - [Nebulex.Caching.Decorators.Context](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Caching.Decorators.Context.md): Decorator context struct and stack management.

- Adapter specification
  - [Nebulex.Adapter](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.md): Specifies the minimal API required from adapters.

  - [Nebulex.Adapter.Info](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.Info.md): Specifies the adapter Info API.
  - [Nebulex.Adapter.KV](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.KV.md): Specifies the adapter Key/Value API.
  - [Nebulex.Adapter.Observable](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.Observable.md): Specifies the adapter Observable API.
  - [Nebulex.Adapter.Queryable](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.Queryable.md): Specifies the adapter Query API.

  - [Nebulex.Adapter.Transaction](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapter.Transaction.md): Specifies the adapter Transaction API.

- Built-in adapters
  - [Nebulex.Adapters.Nil](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Nil.md): The Nil adapter is a special cache adapter that turns off the cache. It loses
all the items saved on it and returns nil for all read operations and true for
all save operations. This adapter is mostly useful for tests.

- Built-in info implementation
  - [Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info.md): A simple/default implementation for `Nebulex.Adapter.Info` behaviour.
  - [Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info.Stats](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info.Stats.md): Stats implementation using [Erlang counters][erl_counters].

- Telemetry handlers
  - [Nebulex.Telemetry.CacheEntryHandler](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Telemetry.CacheEntryHandler.md): A Telemetry handler listens to cache command completion events, builds the
corresponding cache entry event, and applies the provided filter and listener.

  - [Nebulex.Telemetry.CacheStatsCounterHandler](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Telemetry.CacheStatsCounterHandler.md): Telemetry handler for aggregating cache stats; it relies on the default
`Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info` implementation based on Erlang counters.
See `Nebulex.Adapters.Common.Info.Stats`.

- Utilities
  - [Nebulex.Time](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Time.md): Time utilities.

  - [Nebulex.Utils](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Utils.md): General purpose utilities.

- Exceptions
  - [Nebulex.CacheNotFoundError](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.CacheNotFoundError.md): It is raised when the cache cannot be retrieved from the registry
because it was not started or does not exist.

  - [Nebulex.Error](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Error.md): This exception represents command execution errors. For example, the cache
cannot perform a command because it has not started, it does not exist, or
the adapter failed to perform it for any reason.
  - [Nebulex.KeyError](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.KeyError.md): Raised at runtime when a key does not exist in the cache.
  - [Nebulex.QueryError](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.QueryError.md): Raised at runtime when the query is invalid.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix nbx](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nbx.md): Prints Nebulex tasks and their information.
- [mix nbx.gen.cache](https://nebulex.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nbx.Gen.Cache.md): Generates a new cache.
